bear.reason: secular leg: GenAI substitution bites Insights (78% of revenue); multi-year revenue decline; margin held above the COVID trough (FY2020 12.0%) on subscription cost flex; multiple near the own-history band-low (7.46); 9.5x ≈ 5th pctile of the 9.3y band.

base.reason: margin = 7yr clean median 18.45% (rounded to 18.5%) ex the $150M FY25 goodwill impairment — the 14.13% anchor is dragged by the pre-2021 regime (five straight years ran 18-21%). Revenue = consensus FY26E. Multiple deliberately below the 23.4x own-history median (9.3y band): a decelerating top line doesn't re-earn the growth-era multiple.

bull.reason: turn proves cyclical: FY27E re-acceleration (+4%); margin near FY2023 best (20.94%); multiple toward but below own-history median.

revenue.method: Legs are set off the committed consensus path rather than round numbers: base IS consensus FY26E, bull IS consensus FY27E (the modelled re-acceleration), and bear takes a multi-year secular decline materially below FY26E to price the GenAI-substitution case.

verdict.rationale: BUY at 141.06. Underwrite PASS 7.04:1 at 140.19 (2026-07-17); re-verified 6.69:1 at entry. Stress: brutal secular bear (rev −20%, margin 13%, 8x → $75.24) still clears 2.02:1 — barely, against the 2.0 bar. Known fragility, accepted: fails only if base multiple compresses to ~12x alongside the secular bear — i.e. only if revenue never re-stabilizes. Side taken: overshoot over GenAI disruption — five consecutive years of 18–21% operating margins, absolute EBITDA rising through the de-rate, LTM FCF +$1,064M (~11% FCF yield at spot), priced at ~the 3rd percentile of its own 9.3-year multiple band. Market prices structural decline; committed evidence shows revenue deceleration with an intact earnings base.
reunderwrite_triggers: Q2-2026 print (early Aug): contract-value growth decelerates further or turns negative → re-underwrite the bear leg
revenue below the FY26E consensus path two consecutive quarters → re-test base at 12x
operating margin breaks below ~16% ex one-offs → regime assumption fails
